description: This file defines the TextNormalization class which implements text normalization for Markdown content, including slug generation with configurable length and normalization helpers.

classes.name: TextNormalization
classes.description: A class responsible for normalizing text, particularly for generating URL-friendly slugs within Markdown content, with configurable maximum length.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the maximum length for slug normalization based on external configuration.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes input text into a slug, adding prefix, normalizing, and trimming to specified length.
